topic: The Barber Pole Effect: Polarization and Chirality in Sugar Water

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Polarization Filter
lecture_lines: Light waves oscillate in all directions.
animations: 1. Show light as multi-directional waves in #FFFFFF.
2. Display a vertical polarizer fence in #8888FF using the filter icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/filter.svg].
3. Show wave passing through, becoming vertical.

sections.title: Introduction to Optical Activity
animations: 1. Display a sugar molecule structure using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sugar.svg] in #FF8888.
2. Show polarized light using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/light.svg] entering the molecule region.
3. Visualize the light vector represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/light.svg] rotating as it passes.

sections.title: Mathematical Visualization: The Rotating Vector
animations: 1. Show a 2D arrow representing the electric field vector in #00FFFF, emitted from a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/laser.svg].
2. Display the angle θ = α * c * L in #FFFFFF.
3. Rotate the vector arrow continuously to represent path length L.
4. Show different wavelengths (Red, Blue) passing through a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/prism.svg] while rotating at different speeds.
5. Label the final orientation clearly with #FFFFFF text.

sections.title: The Barber Pole Effect (The Core Phenomenon)
animations: 1. Show white light entering a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/beaker.svg] of solution.
2. Render multiple colored bands rotating at distinct angles.
3. Show the analyzer [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/filter.svg] rotating at the exit.
4. Visualize the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/barberpole.svg] pattern shifting through colors.
5. Highlight the changing exit color as the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/filter.svg] turns.

sections.title: Practical Application: The Sugar Concentration Sensor
animations: 1. Show a light source [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/light.svg], beaker [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/beaker.svg], and detector [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/detector.svg] setup.
2. Label the detector [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/detector.svg] output with 'Concentration %' in #00FF00.
3. Visualize the concentration change adjusting the detected angle at the detector [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/detector.svg].
